name: pl-visual-dataset
title: ChRIS Visual Dataset Indexer
description: Prepare the outputs of a feed for the "visual datasets" feature of ChRIS_ui.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.help: Use default values for --matchers and --options for a well known program's output.  [choices: freesurfer-7.3.3, malpem-1.3, none]

parameters.name: matchers
parameters.help: Regular expressions used to assign tags to files, as stringified JSON or a path to a file relative to inputdir

parameters.name: options
parameters.help: Metadata to go with tag sets, as stringified JSON or a path to a file relative to inputdir

parameters.name: first_run_files
parameters.help: List of files to show on first run, as a stringified JSON list of paths relative to inputdir

parameters.name: first_run_tags
parameters.help: Tags to show on first run as a stringified JSON object
